name: Java
description: A small Java inventory library built with plain javac and a dependency-free test runner; no Maven, Gradle or JUnit, nothing is downloaded. The ten template tasks of docs/MODEL_HETEROGENEITY.md, Part 2.

toolchain.name: javac
toolchain.hint: A JDK 17 or later (javac) on the Harbor's PATH

toolchain.name: java
toolchain.hint: A JDK 17 or later (java) on the Harbor's PATH

tasks.title: Add a member to an existing class
tasks.prompt: In inventory/Item.java add a public method `double getTotalValue()` to the Item class that returns unitPrice times quantity. Give it a Javadoc comment like the other members. Keep the existing tests passing (`javac -encoding UTF-8 -d build -sourcepath . tests/TestRunner.java` then `java -cp build tests.TestRunner`).

tasks.title: Coordinated two-place edit: write a test method and register it
tasks.prompt: Add a public static test method `stockRemoveMoreThanAvailableThrows` to tests/StockTests.java. It adds an item with 2 units and checks that removing 3 units throws InsufficientStockException (inventory/InsufficientStockException.java). A test only runs when it is registered, so also register it in tests/TestRegistry.java. `javac -encoding UTF-8 -d build -sourcepath . tests/TestRunner.java` then `java -cp build tests.TestRunner` must pass.

tasks.title: Fix a bug from a failing test
tasks.prompt: The test priceCalculatorApplyDiscountTenPercent fails (`javac -encoding UTF-8 -d build -sourcepath . tests/TestRunner.java` then `java -cp build tests.TestRunner`). Find and fix the bug in the library code. Do not change or remove the tests.

tasks.title: Edit a file with a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings
tasks.prompt: In config/legacy-codes.properties change maxCodeLength from 8 to 12. Change nothing else. The file is UTF-8 with a byte order mark and CRLF line endings; keep both exactly as they are.

tasks.title: Write tests for an untested function, including negative paths
tasks.prompt: TextUtil.truncate in inventory/TextUtil.java has no tests. Write tests for it as public static methods of a new class tests/TextUtilTests.java and register each one in tests/TestRegistry.java. Cover the normal cases, the boundary where the value is exactly maxLength, and the negative paths (null value, maxLength below 3), checking the exception type each one throws. Do not change inventory/. `javac -encoding UTF-8 -d build -sourcepath . tests/TestRunner.java` then `java -cp build tests.TestRunner` must pass.

mutants.find: if (value == null) throw new NullPointerException("value is required");
throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxLength must be at least 3");
mutants.replace: throw new IllegalStateException("maxLength must be at least 3");

tasks.title: Review a diff with three seeded defects (negative control)
tasks.prompt: Review the change below against its original request. The change is shown as a diff; it is not applied to this repository, so read the diff and the current source of inventory/Stock.java. Report every blocking defect.

seeded.description: The loop starts at index 1 and skips the first SKU.
An unknown SKU makes find return null and item.getUnitPrice() throws NullPointerException instead of UnknownSkuException.
percentOff / 100 is integer division, so the rate is 0 below 100 and no discount is applied.

tasks.title: Review a correct diff (positive control)
tasks.prompt: Review the change below against its original request. The change is shown as a diff; it is not applied to this repository, so read the diff and the current source. Report every blocking defect, and only real ones.

tasks.title: Turn a feature request into an armada-plan
tasks.prompt: Turn the feature request below into a plan of missions for this repository.

tasks.title: Lint a diff with seeded style violations
tasks.prompt: Lint the diff below against STYLE.md in this repository. The diff is not applied. List each violation as its own bullet line naming the rule and the code. Do not edit files.

seeded.description: `var result` instead of an explicit type (rule 1).
Public method suggest has no Javadoc comment (rule 2).
`item.getSku() != "DISCONTINUED"` compares strings by reference instead of with equals (rule 5).
System.out.println in library code under inventory/ (rule 6).

tasks.title: Summarize a voyage
tasks.prompt: Summarize the voyage record below for the team: what was done, what failed and why, and the durable lessons. Do not edit files.
